baseline.value: A significant number of boilers in MSMEs, as well as diesel generator (DG) sets used in MSMEs and commercial/residential complexes, continue to operate on fossil fuels, contributing to environmental pollution.

target.value: (a): Additional 200 boilers have been converted or installed that operate on cleaner fuels (b): Additional 200 old polluting DG sets are retrofitted to install emission control devices or to operate in dual-fuel mode (c): Additional 200 new DG sets are installed that comply with CPCB standards.
